item.title: Meal - Chicken Pesto Flatbread
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Flatbread - 2
  • Chicken breast - 300g
  • Pesto - 2 tbsp
  • Mozzarella - 1/2 cup
  • Spinach - 1 cup

Directions

  1. Cook chicken and slice
  2. Spread pesto on flatbread
  3. Add chicken, cheese and spinach
  4. Bake until crispy

Macros

  • Calories - 480
  • Protein - 35g
  • Carbs - 42g
  • Fat - 18g
